projects.name: Milwaukee Air Cargo Center (MACC)
projects.summary: A new $80 million, 333,545-square-foot air cargo facility has opened at Milwaukee Mitchell International Airport. Developed through a public-private partnership, the center aims to significantly boost the region's air freight traffic by offering a lower-cost and more efficient alternative to Chicago O’Hare.

projects.name: Microsoft Data Center Campus
projects.summary: Microsoft has received backing from village planners for a revised plan for its data center campus in Mount Pleasant. The updated proposal features fewer buildings but expands the overall footprint to more than 5.8 million square feet of space, indicating a significant ongoing development.

projects.name: Milwaukee, Racine, Kenosha Commuter Rail
projects.summary: A commuter rail plan connecting Milwaukee, Racine, and Kenosha is advancing, with the project now awaiting federal funding. This significant infrastructure proposal aims to serve numerous cities in Southeastern Wisconsin and potentially connect to Chicago’s Metra line.

projects.name: Kinnickinnic Apartment Complex
projects.summary: Redevelopment plans have been publicly revealed for a new apartment complex proposed on Kinnickinnic Avenue. The developer, who is also involved in a nearby library redevelopment project, is plotting this significant residential building in the area.

projects.name: New Burger King South Side
projects.summary: A new Burger King restaurant is planned for Milwaukee's South Side. This development is part of the company's broader strategy to bring retro-branding to its city restaurants.

projects.name: New Halo Cafe
projects.location: Historic Mitchell Street Neighborhood, Milwaukee, WI
projects.summary: A blighted building in Milwaukee's Historic Mitchell Street Neighborhood on the South Side is slated to be transformed into the new Halo Cafe. This project aims to revitalize the street and bring a new commercial establishment to the area.

projects.name: Forensic Science Facility
projects.summary: A new state-of-the-art $245 million forensic science facility for the Milwaukee County Medical Examiner and the State Crime Lab has been celebrated by officials. This significant project is described as a 'watershed moment' for forensic science in the region.

projects.name: Walnut Way Community Solar Project
projects.summary: The Walnut Way Conservation Corp has secured $1.1 million in funding for a new community solar project in Milwaukee's Walnut Way neighborhood. This initiative aims to empower the community through local ownership of power assets.

projects.name: Mystic Bar (Former Angelo’s Piano Lounge)
projects.summary: A new upscale tarot-themed bar is planning a 'mystic makeover' for the former Angelo’s Piano Lounge on Milwaukee's Lower East Side. This project involves transforming a legendary local establishment into a new commercial venue.

projects.name: Residential and Commercial Development (620 Ryan Road)
projects.scale: 313 residential units · fast-food restaurant · convenience store · clubhouse · swimming pool
projects.summary: JD McCormick Properties is proposing a significant mixed-use development at 620 Ryan Road in Pewaukee, featuring 313 residential units, a convenience store, and a fast-food restaurant. The plans, which also include a clubhouse and swimming pool, have been submitted to the village’s Plan Commission for review.

projects.name: Butter’d Up Kitchen & Bar (Rebrand of Habanero’s)
projects.scale: Commercial restaurant exterior refresh and rebrand
projects.summary: The Habanero’s Mexican Restaurant & Margarita House in Greenfield is planning a rebranding and renovation, to become Butter’d Up Kitchen & Bar. The project includes an exterior refresh of the building and has been submitted to the city’s Plan Commission for approval.

projects.name: Hops & Pops Drive-Thru Beverage Store
projects.summary: Hops & Pops LLC is planning a new drive-thru beverage store in Slinger, to be located within the Windy Hill Condominium development. The proposal, which would allow customers to browse from their vehicles, has been filed with the village’s Plan Commission.

projects.name: Milwaukee Cruise Ship Dock
projects.summary: The project to construct or significantly expand a cruise ship dock in Milwaukee has faced multiple completion delays throughout the current year.

projects.name: Port Washington Data Center Campus
projects.summary: A judge has dismissed a legal challenge against the $15 billion incentive package for a new data center campus in Port Washington, clearing a significant hurdle for the project to proceed.

projects.name: Moss Universal Park (Wisconsin Avenue Park Overhaul)
projects.summary: Groundbreaking has occurred for Moss Universal Park, a multi-phase project to transform Wisconsin Avenue Park into a universally accessible public space, with fundraising efforts still ongoing.

projects.name: Metcalfe Park Development
projects.summary: A nonprofit organization received city commission approval for an ambitious mixed-use 'liberation hub' development in Milwaukee's Metcalfe Park neighborhood. This project aims to bring significant new amenities and uses to the area.

projects.name: West Allis Apartment Complex Renovation
projects.summary: The City of West Allis approved a $1.5 million loan to Ogden & Company for the renovation of an apartment complex that sustained damage from flooding last year. The loan facilitates the repair and restoration of the residential property in West Allis.

projects.name: Weldall Manufacturing Headquarters Expansion
projects.summary: Weldall Manufacturing recently completed a 52,800-square-foot expansion project at its headquarters facility in Waukesha. This significant addition increases the company's operational capacity for manufacturing medium to heavy weldments and machining.

projects.name: INNIO Waukesha Facility Expansion
projects.summary: Gas engine manufacturer INNIO plans to invest $300 million in an 83,000-square-foot expansion of its Waukesha facility. This major expansion, previously announced, is expected to add 500 jobs over the next several years, enhancing the company's operations.

projects.name: Northwestern Mutual Tower Overhaul
projects.summary: Northwestern Mutual's $500 million renovation of its downtown Milwaukee tower is nearing completion, with the insurance company preparing the building for its first employees.

projects.name: Peacock Lounge (Bartolotta's new downtown restaurant)
projects.scale: New cocktail lounge within a new restaurant
projects.summary: Bartolotta's is offering a sneak peek of the Peacock Lounge, a new cocktail lounge set to operate within the company's forthcoming downtown Milwaukee restaurant.

projects.name: Redwall Screen Printing Third Building
projects.summary: Oak Creek-based Redwall Screen Printing has expanded its operations by acquiring and beginning to operate out of its third building, supporting its growth to 150 employees.

projects.name: Seton Catholic Schools New School Buildings
projects.summary: Seton Catholic Schools is opening two new school buildings in Milwaukee for St. Rafael the Archangel School and Prince of Peace School on August 24, marking the first new parish Catholic school construction in the city in nearly 60 years.

projects.name: WHEDA Affordable Housing Projects
projects.summary: The Wisconsin Housing and Economic Development Authority (WHEDA) has announced $50 million in loans to fund 22 new affordable housing projects statewide, including developments in Milwaukee County and Sheboygan, which are expected to create nearly 1,900 workforce housing units.

projects.name: Southside Townhomes
projects.summary: Work has begun on new owner-occupied, affordable townhomes on Milwaukee's Southside. This project by VIA CDC aims to increase affordable housing options in the area.

projects.name: Data Center Power Line Plan (Port Washington)
projects.summary: Regulators have forced a redo for ATC's $1.7 billion power line plan for a data center in Port Washington, revoking the application due to its changing scope. This decision impacts a significant energy infrastructure project in the area.

projects.name: Key Bike Trail Extension
projects.summary: Milwaukee has secured a grant to extend a key bike trail, connecting the city more thoroughly with its south suburbs. This infrastructure project aims to enhance regional connectivity.

projects.name: Affordable Housing Conversion
projects.summary: A state authority has endorsed an affordable housing conversion project in Milwaukee, overruling prior rejection by the city. This project, spearheaded by California organizations, aims to create new affordable housing units.

projects.name: Milwaukee Public Museum Site Redevelopment
projects.summary: Milwaukee County is soliciting development proposals for the current Milwaukee Public Museum site, which will become vacant next year. The move of the museum opens up a significant downtown parcel for redevelopment.

projects.name: Penny Lane Apartments
projects.location: Village of Somers, Kenosha County, WI
projects.developer: 1665 Penny Lane LLC (affiliate of RE Development Solutions, Inc.)
projects.summary: A 108-unit apartment building is planned for a vacant 5-acre site along Lake Michigan in the Village of Somers. Plans for the ground-up residential development have been submitted to the village’s Plan Commission.

projects.name: Wipfli Headquarters Relocation
projects.summary: Accounting firm Wipfli plans to relocate its corporate headquarters from Wauwatosa to downtown Milwaukee. This move represents a significant commercial lease or renovation project in the downtown area.

projects.name: Medical College of Wisconsin Student Housing
projects.summary: The Medical College of Wisconsin is constructing its first-ever student housing, a $70 million, four-story complex comprising 266 units. This project aims to provide more affordable housing options on the campus.

projects.name: Carmen Southgate Campus
projects.summary: Carmen Schools has unveiled its new $55 million Southgate Campus, a three-story school featuring a STEAM lab, a large gym, and common areas. The new campus is scheduled to open later this month.

projects.name: Concordia University Wisconsin School of Nursing Expansion
projects.summary: Concordia University Wisconsin is investing in a major expansion of its School of Nursing facilities to address growing shortages in nursing and healthcare professionals. This initiative aims to strengthen the region's healthcare workforce pipeline.

projects.name: The Harvest at Pabst Farms
projects.scale: Mixed-use combining housing, employment, retail, hospitality, recreation, open space
projects.summary: The Harvest at Pabst Farms is a large mixed-use master-planned community in Oconomowoc, designed to integrate housing, employment, retail, hospitality, recreation, and open spaces. Developed by Cobalt Partners, the project aims to support regional growth by addressing various community needs.

projects.name: Oak Creek Affordable Housing Subdivision
projects.summary: Milwaukee County is pushing for federal funding to develop a new affordable housing subdivision in Oak Creek, aligning with County Executive David Crowley's broader strategy for housing initiatives.

projects.name: Teutonia Avenue Lounge and Restaurant
projects.location: Northside Shopping Center, Teutonia Avenue, Milwaukee, WI
projects.summary: A proposal for a new lounge and restaurant on Teutonia Avenue within a Northside Shopping Center is seeking city approval. The venue aims to offer brunch, live music, and cater to a 30-plus crowd.

projects.name: Seeds of Health High School Expansion
projects.summary: Seeds of Health announced plans to close one of its high schools while expanding another, indicating significant changes to its educational facilities within Milwaukee Public Schools' partner network.

projects.name: Trap Kitchen Soul Food Restaurant
projects.location: W. Becher St., Near South Side, Milwaukee, WI
projects.summary: A new soul food restaurant named Trap Kitchen is planned for a building on W. Becher Street in Milwaukee's Near South Side. The project involves transforming a space previously known for illegal after-hours parties into a legitimate dining establishment.

projects.name: Milwaukee County Courthouse Project
projects.summary: An $897 million Milwaukee County Courthouse project has hit a major roadblock after a county committee voted to block a referendum for its funding from appearing on the November ballot, potentially halting the project indefinitely.

projects.name: Milwaukee County Courthouse Project
projects.summary: A proposed $897 million project for the Milwaukee County Courthouse is facing political challenges, with the finance chair attempting to block a public referendum that would allow the project to move forward. This significant public undertaking is currently in a critical public approval phase.

projects.name: Amani Homeownership TIF
projects.summary: A proposed Tax Incremental Financing (TIF) district in Milwaukee's Amani neighborhood aims to spur the development of 95 new single-family homes. This initiative is designed to expand homeownership opportunities and is part of the Community Development Alliance's ongoing housing pipeline efforts.

projects.name: Former Wausau Equipment Plant Conversion to Self-Storage
projects.location: New Berlin Industrial Park, New Berlin, WI
projects.summary: An affiliate of Cedarburg Storage Company LLC has acquired the former Wausau Equipment plant and headquarters in New Berlin. The site, vacated by Wausau Equipment, is expected to be redeveloped and converted into a new self-storage facility.

projects.name: Kinship Community Food Center Expansion
projects.summary: Kinship Community Food Center held a groundbreaking for its $18 million, 28,000 sqft new facility in Milwaukee's Harambee neighborhood. This expansion aims to significantly increase food access, workforce development, and support services for the community.

projects.name: Bay View Affordable Housing
projects.summary: A controversial $33 million, 100-unit affordable apartment complex in Milwaukee's Bay View neighborhood received unanimous approval and a subsidy from the Common Council. This project aims to bring new affordable housing options to the area.

projects.name: Fox Communities Credit Union - Oconomowoc Branch
projects.summary: Fox Communities Credit Union filed plans with Oconomowoc's Plan Commission to build a new branch location at 1283 Olympia Fields Drive. This proposed facility would mark the credit union's second branch in southeastern Wisconsin.

projects.name: Bay View Site Development
projects.summary: The City of Milwaukee is restarting its efforts to develop a long-vacant site in Bay View. A conceptual plan has been proposed for a 14-story tower with lake views, aiming to bring significant development to the prominent location.

projects.name: Bay View Affordable Development
projects.summary: An affordable housing development located in Bay View has received a crucial municipal approval, despite some opposition. This significant milestone allows the project to move forward in the development process.

projects.name: Dunkin' (Wauwatosa)
projects.summary: A new Dunkin' location is proposed for a former Starbucks site at 151 N. Mayfair Road in Wauwatosa. A conditional use permit application has been filed with the city's Plan Commission for the renovation of the existing commercial building.

projects.name: New Apartment Building for Walker’s Point
projects.summary: A new apartment building is planned for the Walker's Point neighborhood in Milwaukee, which will replace a surface parking lot. This development aims to add new housing options to the area.

projects.name: Austin Commons
projects.summary: The Milwaukee Common Council has advanced partial funding for Austin Commons, a delayed affordable housing development located in the Bay View neighborhood. This critical funding decision moves the project forward to provide much-needed affordable housing.

projects.name: Northwestern Mutual’s downtown headquarters campus reconstruction
projects.summary: Northwestern Mutual is undertaking a substantial $500 million reconstruction project at its downtown Milwaukee headquarters campus. This major renovation is one of the significant economic development initiatives shaping southeastern Wisconsin.

projects.name: 100 East redevelopment
projects.summary: The planned 100 East redevelopment is noted as a significant economic development project located in downtown Milwaukee. This project is anticipated to contribute to the future growth and transformation of southeastern Wisconsin.
